name: Cat-Cow
steps: Start on hands and knees with your wrists beneath your shoulders and knees beneath your hips.
Exhale as you tuck your pelvis, drop your head, and round your back toward the ceiling.
Inhale as you tilt your pelvis forward, soften your belly, and lift your chest and gaze gently.
Continue flowing smoothly between both positions in time with your breath.
tips: Let the curve travel smoothly along your entire spine.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears and avoid forcing your lower back into pain.
